# CoolRight

> Air conditioning, heating and ventilation installed, serviced and maintained
> across London and the whole of the South East of England. Residential,
> commercial and bespoke. F-Gas registered engineers.

## What we do

- Wall-mounted split air conditioning installation
- Multi-split systems, two to five indoor units from one outdoor unit
- Ducted systems and ceiling cassettes for offices, retail and higher-end homes
- Air to air heat pumps, used for heating as much as for cooling
- Ventilation, extract and whole-house MVHR
- Servicing plans, annual for domestic and six-monthly for heavy commercial use
- Repairs, leak detection and recharge to the correct weighed-in charge
- Commercial work, including comms and server room cooling, and F-Gas logging

## What happens after an enquiry

1. We reply the same day.
2. Where we need to see the space to price it accurately, we visit. The visit
   is free and usually takes 30 to 60 minutes.
3. A fixed written quote follows within 24 hours of that visit. The equipment is
   named, the work is itemised, and the price is fixed unless the scope changes
   and you agree it first.
4. Most single-room domestic installs take one day. Commissioning readings,
   warranty registration and a walkthrough of the controls are included.

## How pricing works

Every job is quoted after somebody has looked at it. We do not publish a tariff,
because the difference between a straightforward installation and an awkward one
is the pipe route, the condenser position and the access, and none of those can
be judged over the phone.

What moves a price most: where the outdoor unit can go, how far the pipe has to
run and whether it can be hidden, the equipment specified, and the electrical
supply. Commissioning, testing, waste removal and warranty registration are
included rather than added afterwards.

Cost guides with honest ranges are published at /guides as each one is written.

## Areas covered

Greater London and the whole of the South East, including Kent, Surrey, Essex,
Hertfordshire, Buckinghamshire, Sussex, Berkshire, Oxfordshire, Hampshire and
the Isle of Wight.
